interpretation: Trace overhead means no measured pass can replace the original unprofiled acceptance or resolve the failed CI gate.
Correlate only sender-renderer/main-thread events using the recorded performance mark and time origin; do not attribute peer or background-thread GC.
A wall/thread-CPU gap under intentional 4x CPU throttling alone does not prove host contention.
A later traced pause can identify a mechanism, but cannot retroactively establish the exact cause of the unprofiled CI event.
Select a production remedy only if supported by the source and evidence; preserve every original failure, workload, numerical budget and first-attempt rule.
